caption:
Before the next video: two short phrases.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6406: easy on the tongue, heavy in the balance, dear to the Most Merciful.

Say them now, then once more on your way somewhere today.

Save this and say them daily.

📖 Sources
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6406 (Sahih, tr. Muhsin Khan) — sunnah.com/bukhari:6406
Full text: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, 'Subhan Allah Al- `Azim and 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi
• Recitation: Qur'an 33:41-42 — Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary (EveryAyah.com) — quran.com/33/41-42
